Bhabbe.g: ettha ye ariyamaggappaṭivedhassa anucchavikā upanissayasampannā kammāvaraṇakilesāvaraṇavipākāvaraṇarahitā, te bhabbā.

Bhabbo.g: so yathāvutto sammāpaṭipajjamāno puggalo pubbabhāge samathavipassanābalena sabbavitakke yathārahaṁ tadaṅgādivasena vūpasametvā ṭhito vipassanaṁ ussukkāpetvā maggapaṭipāṭiyā arahattamaggañāṇasaṅkhātaṁ nibbānasaṅkhātañca anuttaraṁ sambodhiṁ phuṭṭhuṁ adhigantuṁ bhabbo arahā.

evaṁ kilesamalappahāneneva sabbassa kammavaṭṭassa parikkhīṇattā anavasesavipākavaṭṭakhepanāya sakalasaṁsāravaṭṭadukkhaparikkhayabhūtāya vā anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā bhabbo ekantenetaṁ pāpuṇitunti evamettha attho daṭṭhabbo.
so yathāvuttaṁ sabbaṁ papañcaṁ pariccajitvā yathā Satthārā vuttāya sammāpaṭipattiyā, tathā passitabbato tādiso saṁsāre bhayaṁ ikkhatīti bhikkhu uttamaṁ sambodhiṁ arahattaṁ pattuṁ arahati.

so yathāvutto sammā paṭipajjamāno puggalo pubbabhāge samathavipassanābalena sabbavitakke yathārahaṁ tadaṅgādivasena vūpasametvā ṭhito vipassanaṁ ussukkāpetvā maggapaṭipāṭiyā arahattamaggañāṇasaṅkhātaṁ nibbānasaṅkhātañca anuttaraṁ sambodhiṁ phuṭṭhuṁ adhigantuṁ bhabbo samatthoti.
vacanaṁ kevalaṁ bodhisattassa bhabbataṁ dīpeti, na niyatassa niyāmokkamanaṁ, tasmā asādhakaṁ.

bhabbāva.g: atha kho te kukkuṭapotakā vuttanayena sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṁ bhabbāva.
atha kho te kukkuṭapotakā vuttanayena sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṁ bhabbāva.
atha kho te kukkuṭapotakā vuttanayena sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṁ bhabbāva.

bhabbo.g: ahaṁ dāni duvidhepi kāme paṭisevituṁ abhabbo.
kilesābhisaṅkhārānaṁ abhinibbijjhanato abhinibbidhāsaṅkhātaṁ ariyamaggaṁ adhigantuṁ na ca bhabbo.

bhabbarūpatāyā.g: ayaṁ bhikkhu bhabbarūpo, imassa kathaṁ gahetuṁ yuttantipi mā gaṇhittha.

bhabbarūpatāya.g: ayaṁ bhikkhu bhabbarūpo, imassa kathaṁ gahetuṁ yuttantipi mā gaṇhittha.

Bhabbarūpova.g: abhabbopi attā bhabbarūpova bhabbajātiko viya bālānaṁ avipassakānaṁ dissati.
vipannajjhāsayopi māyāya sāṭheyyena ca paṭicchāditasabhāvo bhabbajātikaṁ viya attānaṁ dasseti.

bhabbarūpova.g: yo idha sattaloko bhabbarūpova hetusampanno viya hutvā dissati, sopi mohasambandhano mohena paliguṇṭhito attahitāhitaṁ ajānanto hite na paṭipajjati, ahitaṁ dukkhāvahaṁ bahuṁ ca apuññaṁ ācināti.

bhabboti.l: bhabboti vuccati, na so abhabbo nāmā

Bhabbābhabbe.g: “mayā desitaṁ dhammaṁ paṭivijjhituṁ ayaṁ puggalo bhabbo samattho ayaṁ puggalo abhabbo”ti viditvā paccakkhaṁ katvā bhante sabbaññu tvaṁ cātuddīpikamahāmegho viya dhammadesanāsīhanādena abhītanādena gajjasi sakalaṁ cakkavāḷaṁ ekaninnādaṁ karosi.
